title: N -W F P Agricultural University Amendment Act 1996

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Agricultural University Amendment Act 1996
sections.description:
Short title and Commencement

NORTH﷓WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE AGRICULTURAL UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 1996
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER
PROVINCE AGRICULTURAL UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act further to amend the North‑West
Frontier Province Agricultural University Ordinance, 1981
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 16th October, 1996]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis/96/17136, dated
16‑10‑1996.‑‑The North‑West Frontier Province
Agricultural University (Amendment) Bill, 1996, having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of the North‑West Frontier Province on the .30th
September, 1996 and assented to by the Governor of the North‑West
Frontier Province on the 14th October, 1996 is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Legislature of North‑West Frontier Province.
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Act may be called the North‑West
Frontier Province Agricultural University (Amendment) Act, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Ammendment of Section 14 of N.-W.F.P. Ordinance, I of 1981

NORTH﷓WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE AGRICULTURAL UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 1996
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER
PROVINCE AGRICULTURAL UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act further to amend the North‑West
Frontier Province Agricultural University Ordinance, 1981
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 16th October, 1996]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis/96/17136, dated
16‑10‑1996.‑‑The North‑West Frontier Province
Agricultural University (Amendment) Bill, 1996, having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of the North‑West Frontier Province on the .30th
September, 1996 and assented to by the Governor of the North‑West
Frontier Province on the 14th October, 1996 is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Legislature of North‑West Frontier Province.
2. Amendment of section 14 of
N.‑W.F.P. Ordinance, I of 1981.‑‑In the North‑West
Frontier Province Agricultural University Ordinance, 1981 (N.W. F. P. Ordinance
I of 1981), in section 14, in subsection (1),‑‑
(a) after clause (iii), the
following new clause shall be inserted, namely:
"(iii a) Secretary
Agriculture, Government of the North‑West Frontier Province, or his
nominee not below the rank of an Additional Secretary; ";
(b) for clause (iv) the following
shall be substituted, namely:
"(iv) The Secretary
Education, Government of North‑West Frontier Province or his nominee not
below the rank of an Additional Secretary;", and
(c) After clause (iv), as, so
substituted, the following new clauses shall be inserted, namely:
"(iv a) Secretary, Services
and General Administration Department, Government of North‑West Frontier
Province, or his nominee not below the rank of an Additional Secretary;
(iv b) Secretary Finance,
Government of North‑West Frontier Province, or his nominee not below the
rank of an Additional Secretary."
